items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Well, Sam, I played with Sam Morgan from 1921 until 25.

ctx.x: What about Sam Morgan? I want to get on that.
Sam? Sam? Yeah. Well, Sam, I played with Sam Morgan from 1921 until 25.
Did he have any good men and his man? Well, yeah. We had me. I was a fan. That's what you stopped. I was a fan. I was a fan.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Told me, told Sam he had a better drummer than why they tried to keep me, you know. So I just stayed on with Sam.

ctx.x: He had me playing with Sam.

And Sam was going on the road every weekend, see, going to Biloxi, Paris Christiane, Bay St. Louis. Well, Manny Gabriel couldn't get off, you see, to go on the road with Sam and play. He was a slate or carpet or something. We was playing at the economy hall one night, and he'd come and ask Buddy to let me go make a trip with him, you see. Buddy didn't like the idea, you know. He figured Sam wanted to take me anyway, you see. I just said come back from California, you see. Mm-hmm. So he said, well, I don't like…

So you were with Buddy a real short length of time. Short length of time, yeah. I wouldn't say it was about too long. Oh, what about Armstrong? You said you played with him at Lollars? Yeah. And you played a lot of little parties with him?

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Sam couldn't read well enough to play a funeral, in other words.

ctx.x: Yeah, uh-huh. They played parades. They played parades with different brass bands, you know. They'd hire them, you know, like a trumpet player wouldn't, couldn't make it. They'd hire them, you know, see. But they'd hire them to play fumes. They would play parades, you know, but you ain't playing nothing, you know. But funerals, they wouldn't hire them, you know. Sam couldn't read well enough to play a funeral, in other words. Buddy either. He could play if you're playing the hymns, you know, like we played, you…
Well, did they have any other brass bands? Oh, yeah. Who were some of the other ones?
